skoobl — online multiplayer draw & guess game

skoobl is a free, browser-based multiplayer party game. One player is given a secret word and draws it on a live shared canvas while everyone else races to guess what it is in real time. Quick rounds, no sign-up, no install — just open the link and play with friends.

How to play

  1. Create a private room and share the join link or code.
  2. Each round, one player draws the secret word on the canvas.
  3. Everyone else types guesses; fastest correct guess scores most.
  4. Take turns drawing and guessing until the game ends.

Features

  • Real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing
  • Private rooms you can share with a link or code
  • English and Arabic word packs, or bring your own custom words
  • Works in any modern browser on desktop and mobile
  • Free to play, no account or download required
